description: This file contains a script that updates the 'bom_level' attribute in BOM (Bill of Materials) documents within an ERP system, specifically for the ERPNext platform. It reloads relevant documents, executes an update SQL statement, and iteratively sets BOM levels for related BOM documents.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Main function that reloads BOM documents, resets BOM levels, and updates BOM hierarchy levels based on their relationships.

methods.name: get_parent_boms(bom_no)
methods.description: Helper function that retrieves parent BOMs for a given BOM number by querying related BOM items.

calls: frappe.db.sql(" update `tabBOM` set bom_level = 0 where docstatus = 1")
